name_zh: 科尔内/拉斯马斯克/扬·布拉格·延森：灵活保障模式与福利国家创新
description_zh: 丹麦"灵活保障"模式由三位跨党派领袖跨越三十年共建： Poul Schlüter (保守党, 1982-93) 推动劳动市场改革； Poul Nyrup Rasmussen (社民党, 1993-2001) 将其制度化为"灵活保障"四支柱(灵活解雇+慷慨失业金+主动劳动政策+终身学习)； Helle Thorning-Schmidt (社民党, 2011-15) 引入数字化公共服务与绿色转型。核心逻辑：企业享有解雇灵活性，工人享有收入保障与再培训权利，国家承担调节成本。这体现了北欧信任资本 (M151) 的制度化——高信任降低交易成本，使"灵活"不演变为"不安定"。
description_en: Denmark's "flexicurity" model built by three cross-party leaders over 30 years: Poul Schlüter (Conservative, 1982-93) drove labor reforms; Poul Nyrup Rasmussen (Social Dem, 1993-2001) institutionalized four pillars (flexible firing + generous unemployment + active labor policy + lifelong learning); Helle Thorning-Schmidt (Social Dem, 2011-15) added digital public services & green transition. Core logic: firms get firing flexibility, workers get income security & retraining rights, state bears adjustment costs. This exemplifies Nordic Trust Capital (M151) institutionalized—high trust lowers transaction costs so "flexibility" doesn't become "insecurity".
reason_zh: 灵活保障是北欧模式在全球化冲击下的自我进化：用制度化信任替代刚性保护，实现企业竞争力与工人安全的动态平衡。三位领袖跨党派接力，展示 M34 制度化制度与 M52 长期主义的复利。
reason_en: Flexicurity is Nordic model's self-evolution under globalization: institutionalized trust replaces rigid protection, achieving dynamic balance of firm competitiveness & worker security. Three leaders' cross-party relay shows compounding of M34 Institutionalization & M52 Long-termism.
steps_zh: 共识建立：雇主联合会+工会联合会+政府三方协商，锁定核心原则
立法锚定：1994/1998/2002 三轮改革法，将四支柱写入法律
主动劳动政策机构化：市镇级就业中心、强制激活措施、技能升级账户制
终身学习融资：成人教育补贴、职业学院网络、企业培训税收抵扣
数字化与绿色延伸：NemID/数字邮箱普及、2030气候法锁定70%减排目标
steps_en: Consensus building: Employer confederation + union confederation + government tripartite lock core principles
Legislative anchoring: 1994/1998/2002 three reform acts writing four pillars into law
Institutionalize ALMP: municipal job centers, mandatory activation, skills upgrade accounts
Lifelong learning finance: adult education subsidies, vocational college network, corporate training tax credits
Digital & green extension: NemID/digital post universal, 2030 Climate Act locks 70% emissions cut
expected_zh: 失业率长期低于欧盟平均，劳动参与率高，企业创新指数领跑，福利国家在开放经济中可持续。
expected_en: Unemployment consistently below EU average, high labor participation, firm innovation index leading, welfare state sustainable in open economy.
case_zh: 2008金融危机丹麦失业率峰值仅6.2%（欧盟10%+），2年内恢复；COVID-19期薪资补贴方案2周上线，保住90%岗位。
case_en: 2008 GFC Denmark unemployment peak 6.2% (EU 10%+), recovered in 2 years; COVID wage subsidy live in 2 weeks, saved 90% jobs.
cross_cultural_impact: EU flexicurity principles 2007; ILO model; OECD benchmark for labor market resilience
